name: s3_score_threshold_verification

SThreeProbeHazard.desc: hazard rate used in the change-point probe

SThreePrZeroResponsePeak.desc: peak P(r=0) in the 50-record window after the 6-sigma shift

SThreePrZeroPinnedToHazard.desc: 1 if P(r=0) in the change-point window equals the hazard

SThreePrZeroSteadyMaxDeviation.desc: max |P(r=0) - hazard| after init and before truncation

SThreePrZeroInitValue.desc: P(r=0) at t=0, when the run array has length one

SThreePrZeroTruncatedMean.desc: mean P(r=0) once the run array is truncated

SThreePrZeroTruncatedMax.desc: max P(r=0) once the run array is truncated

SThreeProbeScorePeak.desc: peak returned score in the change-point window

SThreeBindingRows.desc: records examined for which term sets the score

SThreeChangePointBindingRows.desc: records where the change-point branch sets the score

SThreeChangePointBindingPct.desc: share of records where the change-point branch binds

SThreeShortRunWeight.desc: weight on the change-point auxiliary term

SThreeChangePointBindingMeanValue.desc: mean score contributed where the change-point branch sets the score

SThreeThresholdCostOnly.desc: the paper's Eq. (12) cost-only threshold C_FP/(C_FP+C_FN)

SThreeThresholdMatchesPaper.desc: 1 if the implemented threshold equals the paper's Eq. (12)

SThreeLatencyUsesAClock.desc: 1 if the latency module measures wall-clock time

notes: re-measures A1-A4 against the current code; no prose is asserted that a number here does not support
